decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The use hereby permitted shall be carried on only by Promo Executive Cars Limited.
Condition : 2 - The premises shall not be used as a customer waiting area or collection point.
Condition : 3 - The premises shall not contain a drivers' rest room or any other facilities for drivers.
Condition : 4 - The display of advertisements for the chauffeur service shall not take place outside the building known as 12 Central Parade.
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall not be carried on outside the following times: 0700 to 2230 hours.

Condition : 6 - Full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne sound shall be submitted to the local planning authority within one month of the date of this permission and once approved by the local planning authority the works shall be carried out within three months of the approval in accordance with the approved details.
description: Retention of control centre/office use to the rear of unit 12 in connection with a chauffeur service.
